definitions: A plant of the genus Linum, especially Linum usitatissimum, which has a single, slender stem, blue flowers, and small, oily seeds.
The fibre of the flax plant, used for making linen, thread, and rope.
A pale yellowish-grey colour, resembling the colour of undyed flax fibre.
examples: Flax is cultivated for its fibre and seeds.
The finest linen is made from flax.
Her hair was the colour of flax.
